title: Pursuant
summary: PURSU'ANT, adjective [from pursue] Done in consequence or prosecution of any thing; hence, agreeable; conformable. pursuant to a former resolution the house proceeded to appoint the standing committee

inlines.v: PURSU'ANT, adjective [from pursue] Done in consequence or prosecution of any thing; hence, agreeable; conformable. pursuant to a former resolution the house proceeded to appoint the standing committees. This measure was adopted pursuant to a former order.
